JournalKeep.description: A trigger's `keep`: how many entries its journal keeps, or for how long, such as `90d`.

JournalPruned.description:
A person applies a trigger's `keep` at once with `priory journal prune`. Every runner applies it
in log order, unless it names no person.

before.description: Entries written before this time go. Absent when `keep` is a count.

keep.description: The trigger's `keep` in the person's factory, which every runner then prunes the journal by.

person.description: The person who ran `priory journal prune`.

trigger.description: The trigger whose journal it prunes.

description:

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: priory.journal.pruned
